notes.title: 👁️ GYLT GETS A RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
We, [b]Tequila Works[/b], the studio behind [b]RiME [/b]and the upcoming [b]Song of Nunu: A League of Legends Story[/b], among other titles, announces [b]July the 6th [/b]as the chosen release date for its [b]delicate horror game GYLT [/b]on new platforms.

After its release as an exclusive launch title on Google Stadia in 2019, the game will be now accessible to new players on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series, Xbox One and PC, with wishlist open on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2206210/GYLT/

Thank you for your support and stay tuned to our social media channels for more exciting news! Look for us at [b]@TequilaWorks[/b] on [url=https://twitter.com/TequilaWorks]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/tequilaworks/]Instagram[/url].
